children: National CineMedia closed its acquisition of Captivate for an enterprise value of $275.0M, funded with a new $275.0M first lien term loan, cash, and a new $25.0M revolver of which $10M was drawn.
Adds a scaled office/residential DOOH network; changes growth mix.
Leverage increases; debt service and covenants may impact flexibility.
Provides liquidity for integration; signals near-term cash needs.
Removes execution risk; integration and synergies now key.
Larger footprint could boost ad inventory and pricing power.

This is a mid-cycle move extending NCM beyond cinema into broader digital out-of-home with scale. A larger catalyst requires clear synergy delivery, leverage management, and evidence of revenue growth from cross-network sales.
